must_identify.item: Pods are in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull because the tag nginx:1.27-alpne does not exist
must_identify.evidence: Error: The Docker image "nginx:1.27-alpne" cannot be found because the tag name is misspelled.

must_identify.item: The old pods are still serving (rollout stuck, not an outage)

notes: The RCA never says the old ReplicaSet is still serving. Its Service finding ('The frontend pod is not passing its readiness check, so the Service cannot route traffic to it') implies an outage and misreads the image-pull failure as a readiness problem. A reviewer should check whether the old pods were actually healthy endpoints at analysis time.
